name: Projects
line: Curriculum, campus and garden. The work that runs for years.
frame_line: A project runs for years. It has a curriculum, a plot of land or one community behind it, and the honest measure of it is what was still standing after the funding ended.

name: Campaigns
line: Public pressure with a name on it, since We for Yamuna in 2000.
frame_line: A campaign pushes. It picks one thing — a river, the air, a planting season — and refuses to be finished with it. The oldest one here has been pushing since 2000.

name: Journeys
line: A thousand kilometres on one river, or five days in a village.
frame_line: A journey goes. You leave the city, or you walk into the part of it you have only ever driven past, and the place makes the argument instead of us.

statement.line: You cannot brief someone into caring.

name: Events
line: Workshops, concerts and plays. One night at a time.
frame_line: An event invites. It happens in public, it is open to whoever turns up, and then it is over.
